title: CNVs
bodyHtml: This genetic variant class is composed of copy number variants (CNVs). Most CNVs overlap both coding and noncoding genomic regions, and CNVs associated with ASD often overlap genes that are known to be individually associated with ASD. CNVs are listed here by their genomic coordinates, as well as the genes they completely overlap, stratified by whether these overlapped genes have themselves previously been associated with ASD. Of note, all CNVs identified in Fu et al., 2022 (PMID: 35982160) do not completely overlap any protein-coding gene. However, given the increasing interest in noncoding variation in ASD, we have chosen to still include these CNVs in Consensus-ASD for those interested.
